articles.title: First-Day Jitters? These Fifth Graders Have a Plan!
articles.summary: At one LA school, fifth graders buddy up with new kindergarteners to help them feel brave. They even have a stuffed raccoon named Rocket for comfort. It's a cool tradition that makes the first day less scary!

articles.title: King Charles Sends a Letter About Harry and Meghan: Here's What It Says
articles.summary: King Charles sent an official letter to make it clear that Prince Harry and Meghan are still not "working" royals. They won't use their royal titles for official duties. It's all about avoiding confusion!

articles.title: Kosovo Joins the Team! Another Country Signs Up for Gaza Peacekeeping Force
articles.summary: Kosovo just signed an agreement to send peacekeepers to Gaza as part of a US-led force. They join countries like Indonesia and Morocco. The goal is to help keep peace after the war.
